title: A Subway Ride Turns Into a Comedy Show
summary:
It is not every day that running errands turns into a comedy show on the New York City subway. But that is what happened to Debbie Shields, a Brooklyn bar owner who runs a comedy night.

Shields was on her way to see her accountant when she started talking with comedian Conan O'Brien. She had no idea what she was walking into, but she was ready. 'If you give it to me, I give it right back to you,' she later said.

O'Brien was a guest on SubwayTakes, a popular internet talk show hosted by comedian Kareem Rahma. Near the end of the episode, O'Brien joked that he and Shields used to be married. Shields fired back at once: they had two kids. 'One's in medical school, the other one's in jail,' she said, and O'Brien cracked up.

O'Brien told New York Magazine he would love to work with Shields again. Since the episode aired, she has become an internet sensation, with calls coming in from Japan, Australia and England.
why_it_matters: It shows that being ready to speak up and be yourself can turn an ordinary day into something special.
